answer_1.quote: We extrinsically evaluate the quality of the HPLT v2 parallel data by measuring the performance of MT models trained on it.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates machine translation models trained on HPLT v2, including models translating to and from English and other languages, using BLEU, chrF++, and COMET-22-DA metrics.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate all models on the FLORES-200 benchmark (NLLB Team et al., 2024) using BLEU, chrF++, and COMET-22-DA.

answer_4.quote: We manually inspected a random sample of documents from the cleaned monolingual datasets in 22 languages.
answer_4.guideline: We asked participants to annotate any documents which look like pornographic content, look unnatural, and/or are not in the target language.
